# Sreya Dutta — Documentation Portfolio

> Technical writer and documentation systems builder with 25+ years across enterprise documentation, curriculum development, and developer content. Currently at Oracle, writing and diagramming cross-product cloud solution content for the Oracle Architecture Center and building AI-assisted DITA authoring workflows.

Public work is linked and independently verifiable: Oracle Architecture Center solutions name me as a contributor in their Acknowledgments sections, and the Write the Docs guide is published on the community's own site. Internal work is described and labeled as internal, with its public analogs linked.

## AI workflows and documentation tooling

- [SwiftPay DITA Conversion Workflow](https://sreyadox.github.io/case-studies/swiftpay-dita-workflow.html): Public, runnable Claude Code agent workflow that converts Word, Confluence, and JIRA source content into validated DITA topics behind a human-review gate. Companion to my three-part blog series on AI workflow design.
- [Troubleshooting Knowledge Workflow](https://sreyadox.github.io/case-studies/troubleshooting-kb-workflow.html): Internal Oracle workflow converting support knowledge articles into DITA troubleshooting topics with explicit cause and remedy markup, so the output is reliably consumable by external LLMs and grounds an internal Slack support bot.
- [SVG-to-draw.io Converter](https://sreyadox.github.io/case-studies/figma-drawio-converter.html): Figma Make app I built that converts published SVG architecture diagrams into editable draw.io files, shipped to customers through the Download Diagram button on Oracle solution pages.
- [Learning the Product by Running It](https://sreyadox.github.io/case-studies/fusion-apps-hands-on.html): Internal Oracle Fusion Applications work — planned and set up the environment and data for a five-day train-the-trainer program on an early adopter release, tested every hands-on activity in it before delivery, and re-verified the curriculum against each subsequent release. The working method is verifying the product by operating it before writing about it.

## Developer and product documentation

- [Clover Developer Documentation](https://sreyadox.github.io/case-studies/clover-developer-docs.html): Developer-facing API documentation owned in the Developer Relations team at Clover (Fiserv). Rebuilt the app billing documentation by reading the service code with the owning engineer after institutional product knowledge was lost — metered and subscription billing models, the merchant account lifecycle, payment delays, and regional differences. Separately owned the Orders API documentation through the 2020 shift to online ordering. Answered developer questions directly and fed support friction back into the docs and into filed bugs and feature gaps. Public docs: https://docs.clover.com/dev/docs/billing-for-apps (legacy Developer Dashboard billing) and https://docs.clover.com/dev/docs/working-with-orders
- [OCI Vision Service Documentation](https://sreyadox.github.io/case-studies/oci-vision.html): Documentation for Oracle's AI image analysis service — object detection, scene classification, OCR, and custom model workflows. Covers the full developer surface: concepts, REST API, SDK usage, model training, and quickstart guides. Authored in DITA and managed in a docs-as-code workflow, committed and pushed via git to Oracle's DevOps SCM build and publish pipeline. The challenge is accuracy and trust: AI service docs must be precise about probabilistic outputs, confidence thresholds, and model limitations without overpromising or underselling. Public docs: https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/vision/using/home.htm

## Published documentation

- [Solution Architectures Published](https://sreyadox.github.io/case-studies/oracle-solutions.html): How I produce Oracle Architecture Center solutions — diagrams built by hand in Figma to Oracle's brand standards, SME content reviewed both manually and through my AI workflow, DITA source generated and validated against style and terminology policy, then authored in Oxygen and published.
- [Findability by Design: SEO and AEO](https://sreyadox.github.io/case-studies/findability-seo-aeo.html): How Architecture Center content is structured for findability — modular DITA topics that each publish to their own URL under a common basepath, shortdesc wrapped in abstract as the search summary, coordinated PR and social amplification with marketing, and performance measured in Adobe Analytics and Oracle Analytics Cloud. The same structure that earns search ranking gives retrieval precision and explicit action targets to agents, via semantic markup that distinguishes a UI control from a command from a variable.

## Community

- [The Technical Writer's Edge](https://sreyadox.github.io/case-studies/wtd-guide.html): A job search guide for the AI era, published April 2026 for the Write the Docs community and built end to end with Claude Code in a Sphinx, reStructuredText, and GitHub docs-as-code workflow.

## Optional

The four solutions below are individual case studies summarized by the Solution Architectures Published page above.

- [Multicloud Private Connectivity](https://sreyadox.github.io/case-studies/multicloud-connectivity.html): Oracle Integration to Oracle AI Database@AWS connectivity, with diagrams built to Oracle's multicloud diagram standards.
- [On-Demand HPC and AI Platform](https://sreyadox.github.io/case-studies/hpc-platform.html): Elastic HPC and AI research platform; I onboarded the SMEs to our diagram standards and worked with Oracle's brand team to get new icons created.
- [Video Knowledge with AI Agents](https://sreyadox.github.io/case-studies/video-knowledge-agents.html): Video transcription and knowledge retrieval with Oracle Autonomous AI Database, MCP, and Oracle AI Agent Studio, produced with the Oracle A-Team.
- [Network Design for Oracle AI Database@AWS](https://sreyadox.github.io/case-studies/network-topology.html): Network topology solution in which every diagram is mine, developed iteratively with the subject matter experts.
